title: Add Contact page route and update navigation to display author details and social links

requirements.summary: Add a dedicated `/contact` route and wire it into the existing TanStack router so it renders within AppLayout and is reachable via navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting `/contact` renders a Contact page within the existing AppLayout.
The Contact page can be reached via the app navigation without relying on a mailto link.

file_operations.description: Create a new ContactPage that uses existing layout patterns and existing shadcn/ui components (e.g., Card, CardContent, Button) to present contact information. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Register a new `/contact` route in the router tree and render the new ContactPage under the existing rootRoute (AppLayout), ensuring the page is navigable in-app.

requirements.summary: Change the header 'Contact' action to navigate to `/contact` via the existing router navigation instead of using a `mailto:` link.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Contact' in the header navigates to `/contact` using the existing router navigation (no `mailto:` link in the header Contact action).

file_operations.description: Replace the current mailto-based Contact action with a router-based navigation action to `/contact` (keep styling consistent using existing Button component). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement Contact page content showing the author name, book title, and clickable Instagram/LinkedIn links with safe external-link attributes.
acceptanceCriteria: The Contact page visibly shows the name "Sana Khan" and the book title exactly as: "Shining Gaze - A search for the unknown".
The Instagram and LinkedIn URLs are rendered as clickable links.
External social links open in a new tab/window and include appropriate `rel` attributes (e.g., `noopener noreferrer`).

file_operations.description: Add visible page content for: Name "Sana Khan"; Book name "Shining Gaze - A search for the unknown"; and render Instagram/LinkedIn as clickable external links opening in a new tab with appropriate rel attributes. Use existing shadcn/ui components where helpful (e.g., Card) without editing `frontend/src/components/ui`. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
